decision.why: Read the domain-specific format audit before choosing an experiment targeting the enlarged Audiveris baseline’s 66.9% melody error and 30 missing pilot chords.
decision.hypothesis: The audit may identify whether omitted chord symbols remain available as OCR text and whether symbolic-format failures contribute to melody errors.
decision.expected_observation: Evidence about recoverable chord text and notation conversion limitations; absent or corrupted OCR chord text would weaken the case for text-to-harmony extraction.

sources.title: Supplied-score benchmark and format audit
sources.claim: 32 development excerpts, seven songs. Enlarged Audiveris recovers 47/200 structured chords; Transcoda omits the chord spine and sometimes repeats notes. Plain OCR words are not yet promoted to harmony. Some outputs fail parsing.
sources.application: Separate image/model failures from output-format and text-to-harmony integration. Compare fixed paired inputs.
sources.limit: References unaudited; chord timing and human correction time unmeasured. No agent comparison.
